description: Search every document Vooks publishes for agents: the agent index, the pricing page, the site overview and the Public Catalog API guide. Returns the matching documents with an excerpt around the match, so you can quote Vooks rather than paraphrasing from memory. Use fetch_doc when an excerpt is not enough.

limit.description: How many documents to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: What to look for, for example "teacher discount", "rate limit" or "free trial".

name: search_docs

excerpt.description: The text around the first match.

matched_terms.description: Which of the query's terms this document actually covers.

matches.description: How many times the query's terms appear.

uri.description: The document's URL. Pass it to fetch_doc.

title: Search the Vooks documentation
